name: Netflix
cancel_steps: 1. Go to Account page. 2. Under Membership & Billing, select Cancel Membership. 3. Confirm cancellation.

name: Spotify
cancel_steps: 1. Log into your Spotify account page. 2. Under Your plan, click Change plan. 3. Scroll to Cancel Spotify and click Cancel Premium.

name: YouTube Premium
cancel_steps: 1. Go to Purchases and Memberships. 2. Click Manage membership next to YouTube Premium. 3. Select Deactivate.

name: Amazon Prime
cancel_steps: 1. Go to Manage Prime Membership. 2. Select End Membership and Benefits. 3. Confirm cancellation.

name: ChatGPT Plus
cancel_steps: 1. Click profile icon in bottom-left. 2. Select Settings -> Subscription. 3. Click Manage -> Cancel plan.

name: Claude Pro
cancel_steps: 1. Open Claude settings. 2. Go to Billing. 3. Click Cancel Subscription.

name: GitHub Copilot
cancel_steps: 1. Go to GitHub Settings -> Billing and plans. 2. Find GitHub Copilot and click Edit -> Cancel Copilot.

name: Google One
cancel_steps: 1. Go to Google One settings. 2. Click Cancel membership. 3. Follow confirmation prompts.

name: iCloud+
cancel_steps: 1. On Apple device, go to Settings -> Apple ID -> iCloud. 2. Tap Manage Account Storage -> Change Storage Plan -> Downgrade Options.

name: Disney+ Hotstar
cancel_steps: 1. Go to My Account. 2. Select Cancel Subscription under Subscription details.
